attribution: Wording in every quote is the authors', copied verbatim from the arXiv abstract. The abstract states no numeric results. The claims below are the authors' theoretical statements; this folder does not prove, check or reproduce them.

method_quotes.quote: only what they pass gets judged.
Agreement shows that agents concur, not that they are right, however many there are.

method_quotes.used_here: precision measured; acceptance-only figure reported as lower_bound
method_quotes.quote: Acceptance by the assessor gives precision but only a lower bound on recall.

method_quotes.used_here: recall estimate only from a judged random sample of not-passed items
method_quotes.quote: recall can be pinned down only by judging items they did not pass

claims.what: bounds hold even with unlimited data
claims.quote: We show what each kind of evidence can establish about their errors, even with unlimited data.

claims.what: upper bound on recall from which agents found which items, and a cap on one more agent's contribution, under stated assumptions
claims.quote: Knowing which agents found which relevant items gives an upper bound on recall if agents' finds are not negatively correlated, and caps what one more agent can add if agents are interchangeable.

claims.what: sample-size claim: any chosen accuracy, sample size independent of the number of agents
claims.note: This folder computes a point estimate only; it states no accuracy, interval or sample-size guarantee.
claims.quote: a random sample of these estimates how many relevant items were missed, to any chosen accuracy, and the sample needed does not grow with the number of agents.
